Spruce House Investment Management Continues to Hold Stake in Wayfair (W); As Facebook (FB) Market Valuation Declined, Coatue Management Lifted Its Holding
May 31, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Philippe Laffont increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 16.43% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Coatue Management Llc bought 803,824 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The hedge fund run by Philippe Laffont held 5.70M shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $910.37 million, up from 4.89M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Coatue Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $555.13B market cap company. The stock increased 2.19% or $4.11 during the last trading session, reaching $191.78. About 22.97 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Spruce House Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Wayfair Inc (W) by 40% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Spruce House Investment Management Llc bought 1.00M shares as the company’s stock rose 19.78% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.50 million shares of the catalog and specialty distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $236.36M, up from 2.50 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Spruce House Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Wayfair Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $8.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.40% or $2.27 during the last trading session, reaching $92.35. About 1.54M shares traded. Wayfair Inc. (NYSE:W) has risen 41.52% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.95% the S&P500.
